summary: Prospective consolidated delivery candidate based on 0056babfc. Integrates PR131 queue scope, bounded statistics/audit reads and existing three-entry panel responsiveness fixes. No release or deployment claim.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing EventStore, session history revision and Web session statistics endpoint.
components.disposition: Bound accounting-only segment cache by segment count and retained source bytes. Reuse unchanged segments, fall back to canonical reads on uncertain layouts. Cache stable scalar statistics per engine and session; isolate response decoration, single-flight cold builds, reclaim inactive locks and invalidate on transcript or event-source changes. Reuse live workspace scope stamping and dispatch checks from PR131 without altering queue ordering or idempotence. Parentage validation uses the returned statistics snapshot.
evidence: Isolated integration: 134 Python tests passed including architecture guards, accounting, source invalidation, concurrent reads, and endpoint regressions.
Directed Pyright: 0 errors, 0 warnings; Ruff passed.
Synthetic eight-request comparison: 101.15 ms full-read baseline, 49.95 ms cold projection, 0.81 ms warm projection; not a production acceptance result.
Integrated Python regression: 76 passed on base 0056babfc, including queue concurrency and statistics/accounting.
components.verification_level: Directed local verification passed; final candidate independent review, full R9, remote CI and production acceptance pending.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Canonical files and authorization remain unchanged. Revision failure or unstable source does not certify a cache entry; fallback is canonical accounting read. No execution or completion authority is introduced.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert of the integrated runtime changes; no data migration.
